results.name: Independent reconstruction audit
results.notes: No refit; checkpoint model and ledger/NAV outputs reconstructed. Formal causality and every strategy gate remain unpassed.

audit.scope: Completed V1R9 bounded Core3 replay: 60/60 new accounts, 3/3 legacy sidecars and 9,714 paired forecasts. The single 2021 fit returned under the approved V1R8 run (3,237 rows); V1R9 reused its root-reviewed checkpoint with current-execution fit count 0. Independent audit status PASS_RECONSTRUCTION_ONLY_NOT_A_STRATEGY_GATE, bound to results SHA DE9F6DFA271F30DF68396B0AEC538E2123794E0091DCB7AAD30835186F5C202F, independently reconstructed all 60 accounts, sidecars and forecasts and confirmed checkpoint model identity and ledger/NAV reconstruction. Ridge beat EWMA on 3/6 fold-symbol MSE comparisons and underperformed on 3/6. All three 2021 main Ridge exposure-matched controls failed, so risk-overlay gains are unproven. 2025 normalized q1 account returns are close to but not identical with the prior Core3 reference: EMA200 0.2165166245642569 vs 0.2165158705882084, MACD+EMA200 0.1496005062733965 vs 0.1495995319309762, and Donchian55/20 0.0815999458258927 vs 0.0815998785104972; this reflects genuine-prior-mark valuation, final-H1-open exit and fee-aware exposure-cap conventions; separate legacy sidecars have trade counts 95/155/41 and numeric net returns equal to the original account_summary.csv literals after literal-to-binary64 parsing. The independent CSV round-trip audit (SHA-256 2E990A8486298EBF248EF80EAE3CFB9D9F48DB5F747E1E2D0189C12990FD16EF; original CSV SHA-256 3B51FF82FC55CCE4DB6825C6DA5BFF85F20B1DC880E44FB7A9A5BE3F17909DA4) confirms equality to parsed numeric references. The runner's two false exact_reference_match flags for EMA200 and Donchian remain preserved because its stored expected constants are shorter precision; MACD's flag is true. This is numeric equality after parsing, not serialized-byte identity. All nine strategy gates remain blocked or not run: venue publication/settlement availability and executable fills/capacity are unproven; lookahead/recursive tests and leverage/liquidation analyses were not run; both windows are exposed/reused; robustness, operational dry-run and live observation gates are not passed. Final workspace pytest terminated 3930 passed, 24 failed, 1 skipped and 242 warnings (native exit 1; 1,962.41 seconds). Classification: 21 pre-existing frozen issues, one OS rename permission failure and two subprocess encoding environment mismatches; the two encoding cases passed a PYTHONUTF8=1 counterfactual with unchanged code/tests, but remain in the full-run total. Twenty-two current failures matched the initial 49-failure baseline; zero were unclassified and zero implementation regressions were found. Mandatory-chain exits were [1, 3, 0, 0, 1]; source verification/import remained fail-closed. See final failure-classification evidence. Independent audit found 15/24 static controls within exposure tolerance and 9/24 outside; all three 2021 main Ridge controls were unmatched. Ridge MSE improvement versus EWMA by fold/symbol was 2021 BTC -2.097248%, ETH +0.414881%, SOL +13.020300%; 2025 BTC -0.051325%, ETH +7.995646%, SOL -7.211068%. These descriptive comparisons do not establish alpha.
